title: How to get the enemy ID of the target enemy in battle?

posts.author: chrimp
posts.body: I want to make a skill that reacts differently for enemy types. I would also like this to be done within a common event in the skill. Simply having the enemy ID returned in a variable would be perfect for it

posts.author: chrimp
posts.body:
rpgLord69 said:
$gameTroop.members()[$gameTemp.lastActionData(5)-1].enemyId()
Click to expand...
Thanks so much! It works perfectly!
